test_save_conversation_writes_under_herm: test that HermesCLI.save_conversation writes snapshots under ~/.hermes/sessions/saved/ instead of CWD
test_save_conversation_empty_history_doe: test that HermesCLI.save_conversation prints a message and skips writing when conversation history is empty
create_stub_cli_with_make_stub_cli: create a stub CLI object with conversation history, model, session ID, and session start using _make_stub_cli
setup_hermes_home_fixture: setup a temporary HERMES_HOME directory fixture that clears the hermes_constants cache for isolated tests
verify_save_conversation_output_and_resu: verify that save_conversation prints the absolute file path and the hermes --resume command with session ID
